description: Corrected Phase 2B for RSI_1h_edge_discovery after Phase 2A reanalysis. Confirms width ridge/stability using lookbacks lb10/lb20/lb35 instead of the earlier lb5/lb10/lb15 plan.
notes: Phase 2A was reanalyzed: lb10 is a sharp point, but lb20 is the better stability center by mean/median PF, mean PnL, robust candidate counts and win rate.
This corrected Phase 2B removes lb5 and restores lb20 and lb35.
Sweeps current_width w10/w11/w12, recent_width r11/r12/r13, width_lookback lb10/lb20/lb35.
No RSI blocker, RSI gate, ADX runner, runtime exits, BE, partial TP, trailing, HTF context, asymmetric rails, wide continuation rails, or high-selectivity w16 branch are included.
